divergences.early-replay: MK3 opens build-16561 replays without tracker events; MK2 cannot decode them.
divergences.nearest-protocol: MK2 decodes game/message events of unbundled builds with the nearest protocol; MK3 only with an exact protocol.
divergences.loop-past-end: MK2 clamps render/seek loops to max(header, timeline); MK3 refuses render and clamps seek to the tracker timeline (one loop shorter).
divergences.export.convert: MK3 publishes no export.convert; the MK2 JSON export is compared against view.inspect + timeline, so the operation row is not claimed.
